title: A brief citing six cases that did not exist
summary: In 2023 a New York federal judge fined lawyers $5,000 after a brief cited six cases that ChatGPT had made up.

beats.say: A lawyer asked Chat G.P.T. for cases. Six did not exist.
A New York law firm filed a brief in a federal court.
beats.cap: A brief filed in federal court

beats.say: One lawyer had used Chat G.P.T. to help research it.
The brief cited six cases that Chat G.P.T. made up.
The judge found the lawyers acted in bad faith.
They had kept defending the fake opinions after the court questioned them.
The fine was five thousand dollars, for the lawyers and their firm.
The judge also said using A.I. for assistance is not improper.
beats.cap: Using AI for assistance: not improper

beats.say: Lawyers still have to make sure the filing is accurate.

facts.note: The Star: one lawyer admitted using ChatGPT to help research the brief; six fictitious citations appeared in it

facts.claim: A Manhattan federal judge fined the lawyers and their firm $5,000 in June 2023
